name: Danish Meatballs
subtitle: Frikadeller
notes: Best if served with lingonberry jam.

items: ¼ to ½ cup half & half or milk
Tiny bit of butter if needed

steps.title: Mix the meat
steps.body: Combine **¾ lb ground beef**, **1 lb ground pork** and **1 large onion**, grated.

steps.title: Add the seasonings
steps.body: Add **½ cup breadcrumbs**, **4 Tbsp flour**, **2 eggs**, **½ tsp salt**, **¼ tsp pepper**, **¼ tsp nutmeg**, **2-3 cloves of garlic** and **½ tsp sage leaves**.

steps.title: Add the half & half
steps.body: Add **¼ to ½ cup half & half or milk**, to bring to a slightly sticky consistency (you shouldn’t be able to form them into a ball).

steps.title: Fry the meatballs
steps.body: Coat a large skillet well with butter, drop heaping tablespoon size clumps onto the skillet. Fry the meatballs on medium-low heat until brown, pressing meat down lightly with a fork so it flattens a bit (like a fat hamburger), then flip (cook approx. 3-5 minutes per side).

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: For gravy: **2 Tbsp drippings from Frickadeller**, tiny bit of butter if needed, **6 Tbsp flour**, **2 cups heavy cream** (milk works too), **2 Tbsp beef bouillon**, salt and pepper.
